Emphasize hands-on project experience with Dockerized deployments and relevant internships or academic projects. Highlight certifications and hackathon participation to demonstrate initiative and practical skills. Use clear, ATS-friendly formatting with role-first headings and keywords aligned to Indian software industry expectations for fresher DevOps roles.

Present a concise, skills-focused profile that aligns with entry-level DevOps job descriptions in India’s software sector.
